narrative.overview: oku draws its visual language from post-Soviet Kyrgyz and Central Asian school geographical atlases: warm uncoated paper stock in daylight, deep night-slate atlas plates after dark, a committed Prussian-cobalt navigation rail, and crisp vermilion border rules.
keyCharacteristics: Light Theme (Daylight Atlas): Built for daytime classroom and home study on warm uncoated parchment (#F5F1E8) with bright paper reading plates (#FFFDF9) that reduce harsh white-screen glare.

Dark Theme (Night Atlas Plate): Built for evening self-study and map exploration on deep charcoal-slate (#12161C) with elevated plates (#1A2029), preserving WCAG AA contrast without losing the cobalt-and-vermilion atlas identity.
Low-Bandwidth Discipline: Zero heavy blurs, zero decorative raster textures; relies on CSS tokens, inline SVG/TopoJSON maps, and system-friendly web fonts.

rules.name: The Reserved Grade Spectrum Rule
rules.body: Grade greens, teals, ambers, and reds (--grade-five through --grade-two) are reserved strictly for 5-point assessment feedback and mastery reporting; ingestion and workflow statuses stay in cobalt, muted stone, and vermilion.

rules.name: The Flat Plate & Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Surfaces carry zero drop shadows; depth and stage hierarchy come strictly from canvas-to-surface tone shifts, 1px hairline borders, and a 4px vermilion rule anchoring the navigation rail and 16:9 projection plates.

rules.name: The Redundant Shape-and-Hue Rule
rules.body: Every Kahoot-style answer tile pairs its fill token (--choice-a through --choice-d) with a distinct geometric SVG mark so classroom projection and color-vision differences never depend on hue alone.

dos: Do ensure every new component defines explicit Light and Dark theme CSS variables and passes WCAG AA contrast (>=4.5:1 for body text).
Do test all headings, badges, and buttons with Kyrgyz Cyrillic characters (Ө, ө, Ү, ү, Ң, ң) to prevent clipping or font fallback mismatches.
Do keep textbook unit payloads lightweight (<300KB, WebP maps, inline SVG).
Do keep QrMatrix locked to #FFFDF9 paper and #12161C modules across both themes so projected classroom QR codes never invert and fail camera scanning.
Do gate stage and drawer animations behind prefers-reduced-motion (.oku-stage-enter, motion-reduce:open:animate-none) and preserve 44px minimum touch targets on coarse pointers (coarse:min-h-[44px]).
donts: Don't use generic pure #FFFFFF + #2563EB SaaS styling or heavy drop shadows.
Don't hide original textbook page numbers (page_break); teachers and students rely on them for classroom alignment.
Don't repurpose --grade-five through --grade-two for generic UI status badges or render Kahoot answer tiles without their paired ChoiceShapeMark geometry.
